svg.title: SYNACK Home Lab: A custom rack combining a TP-Link N300 router, D-Link DGS-108 switch and Raspberry Pi 4, with CAD-adapted, 3D-printed enclosures. Built for Nmap enumeration, Wireshark analysis and student CTF demos.
svg.text: Compact physical networking and security lab
A custom rack combining a TP-Link N300 router, D-Link DGS-108 switch and
Raspberry Pi 4, with CAD-adapted, 3D-printed enclosures. Built for Nmap
enumeration, Wireshark analysis and student CTF demos.
